name: Hold the dots: sunrise
title: Sunrise, Psalm 19:1
caption:
Good morning. Hold the dots and slide.
Every sunrise is a quiet reminder of how big and good God is. The whole sky is telling the story of His handiwork, and we get to wake up inside it.
Psalm 19:1 (BSB)
